data.description: Enjoy a serene lifestyle at the charming community of Jumeirah Heights.

data.answer:
Residents of Jumeirah Heights enjoy beautifully designed landscapes dotted with lakes and parks, perfect for leisurely walks or energizing jogs. The community is tightly knit and provides a variety of retail experiences and gastronomic delights, from casual cafés to fine-dining restaurants.
Living in Jumeirah Heights by Nakheel Properties is particularly appealing to families, with schools and educational facilities easily accessible.

Jumeirah Heights is divided into East and West clusters, consisting of six low-rise apartment buildings with 246 units that boast stunning lake views. These buildings are uniquely named using English alphabets and include a mix of duplexes and townhouses.

The residential offerings at Jumeirah Heights are segmented into three property development zones: The Village Centre, The Clusters, and The Fronds. The Village Centre features two mid-rise buildings, The Clusters comprise three low-rise towers, and The Fronds include two mid-rise buildings and a series of Jumeirah Heights townhouses.

The apartments in Jumeirah Heights Dubai are designed with ample living space. They feature large bedrooms, a study room, built-in wardrobes, and balconies that provide breathtaking views of the skyline and the JLT lakes.

Buying a Property in Jumeirah Heights Area Dubai

Looking for properties in Jumeirah Heights for sale? The 2-bedroom units are selling for around AED 3 million, while 3-bedroom units in Jumeirah Heights for sale will cost minimum AED 3.5 million. Investors interested in this area have a range of options, as there are similar properties for sale in Dubai.

Rental Properties in Jumeirah Heights

Searching for rental apartments in Dubai? Jumeirah Heights rental prices for apartments are in line with broader Dubai market trends. Specifically, 2-bedroom apartments in Jumeirah Heights area for rent us available for AED 185,000 onwards per year. For larger families or those seeking more space, 2-bedroom apartments are available at an annual cost of AED 250,000.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Jumeirah Heights?

data.answer:
Living in Jumeirah Heights offers a tranquil yet vibrant lifestyle. The community is designed to cater to families and professionals alike, boasting lush landscapes and well-appointed facilities. Residents can enjoy various leisure and fitness amenities, creating a balanced environment that combines relaxation with active living. The community's design ensures that all residents have easy access to parks, lakes, and walking paths, fostering a strong sense of community among neighbors.

Public Transportation in Jumeirah Heights

Public transportation options within Jumeirah Heights are accessible, with several bus routes connecting residents to the broader Dubai network. The nearest metro station, Dubai Internet City Station, is just a 15-minute drive away, providing efficient links to the rest of the city. For those relying on public transit, this proximity allows for convenient access to Dubai’s major business districts and recreational areas.

Supermarkets in Jumeirah Heights Dubai

Jumeirah Heights is well-served by a variety of supermarkets. The closest, Spinneys, can be reached within a 10-minute drive. There is also a Choithrams about 12 minutes away by car, ensuring residents have multiple options for their grocery needs without traveling far from home. These supermarkets offer a wide range of products that cater to the diverse culinary tastes and preferences of the community’s residents.

Shopping Malls in and Near the Jumeirah Heights Area

Shopping enthusiasts will find several malls within a short driving distance from Jumeirah Heights. The nearest, Ibn Battuta Mall, is only a 15-minute drive away and offers a comprehensive shopping experience with a wide selection of retail outlets, dining options, and entertainment facilities. For a more luxurious shopping experience, the Mall of the Emirates is approximately a 20-minute drive, featuring an even broader range of international brands and leisure activities, including the famous Ski Dubai.

Schools and Nurseries in Jumeirah Heights

Jumeirah Heights is home to several reputable educational institutions, catering to families with children. The Arcadia Preparatory School, offering a British curriculum, is conveniently located just a 10-minute drive from the community. For younger children, Raffles Nursery in the nearby Springs community is accessible within a 15-minute drive, providing early education in a nurturing environment. These facilities make Jumeirah Heights an ideal location for families seeking quality education options close to home.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Jumeirah Heights

Religious and spiritual life in Jumeirah Heights is well-supported, with various places of worship nearby. The community mosque is centrally located within Jumeirah Heights, offering daily prayers and community services. For Christian residents, the Emirates Baptist Church is a 20-minute drive away, while the Guru Nanak Darbar Sikh Temple is approximately 25 minutes by car, serving the Sikh community. These diverse worship options reflect the multicultural spirit of Dubai and provide spiritual support to the residents.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Jumeirah Heights Area

Healthcare facilities are readily accessible to residents of Jumeirah Heights. Mediclinic Meadows is just a 15-minute drive away, offering a range of medical services from general practice to specialized care. For more comprehensive medical services, the Saudi German Hospital, located about a 20-minute drive from Jumeirah Heights, provides advanced healthcare services including emergency care, surgery, and specialized treatments. These nearby healthcare options ensure that residents have quick access to medical care when needed.

Jumeirah Heights Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

Jumeirah Heights boasts a strategic location in Dubai, close to Emirates Hills, Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT), and The Meadows. This prime positioning allows for easy access to major highways such as Sheikh Zayed Road, making it a 20-minute drive to Dubai Marina and about 25 minutes to Downtown Dubai. Its proximity to key business hubs, leisure destinations, and lifestyle amenities enhances its appeal as a desirable residential area in Dubai, offering convenience and quality of life to its residents.

more_info.question: Things To Do in Jumeirah Heights

data.answer:
Jumeirah Heights is a vibrant community that offers a plethora of activities for its residents. You can spend your days exploring the scenic walking trails, or enjoy a family picnic by the lakeside parks. The community center is a hub of activity, offering workshops, social gatherings, and events that cater to all age groups and interests, making Jumeirah Heights a lively place to live.

Jumeirah Heights Restaurants & Bars

In Jumeirah Heights, residents and visitors have access to some delightful dining options, including The Hamptons Cafe & Restaurant. It offers a cozy, upscale environment where diners can enjoy a variety of dishes that blend classic and contemporary flavors. Brunch & Cake in Jumeirah Islands brings a touch of whimsy and creativity to the dining scene. Renowned for its Instagram-worthy presentations, the restaurant places a strong emphasis on aesthetics as well as taste.

For those willing to venture slightly beyond Jumeirah Heights, the Jumeirah Lakes Towers (JLT) area nearby also offers a plethora of dining options. JLT is known for its eclectic mix of cafes, restaurants, and bars, catering to an international palate with cuisines ranging from Italian and Indian to American and Middle Eastern. This proximity to JLT enhances the culinary landscape available to residents of Jumeirah Heights, providing even more options for dining out.

Beaches Near Jumeirah Heights

The pristine beaches of Dubai are just a short drive from Jumeirah Heights. JBR Beach is approximately 20 minutes away and is perfect for a day of sun, sand, and sea. Here, you can indulge in water sports, sunbathe, or simply enjoy the vibrant atmosphere of the beachfront cafes and shops.

Hotels In and Near Jumeirah Heights Dubai

While Jumeirah Heights primarily serves as a residential area, several luxury hotels are located nearby. The Address Montgomerie, located just a 15-minute drive away, offers luxurious accommodations, golfing facilities, and spa services. This proximity to premium lodging makes it convenient for visitors or residents looking for a local getaway.

Additionally, the nearby Bonnington Hotel in Jumeirah Lakes Towers provides a blend of traditional hospitality and modern amenities. These hotels are conveniently located within a 15-20 minute drive from Jumeirah Heights, making them easily accessible for visitors or residents seeking a staycation or hosting guests.

Attractions and Landmarks Near Jumeirah Heights Dubai

Jumeirah Heights is conveniently located near several key attractions and landmarks that enhance its appeal as a prime residential location in Dubai. Just a 20-minute drive away is the iconic Dubai Marina, known for its luxurious waterfront lifestyle and plethora of dining and entertainment options.

Similarly, the Palm Jumeirah, a world-renowned architectural marvel, is approximately 25 minutes by car and offers beachfront resorts, upscale eateries, and leisure activities. Another significant landmark, the Emirates Golf Club, is just 15 minutes away, providing world-class golfing facilities set against a backdrop of lush greenery. These attractions not only offer recreational opportunities but also add to the desirability of living in Jumeirah Heights, making it a vibrant and convenient place to reside.

Outdoor Activities, Salons and Gyms

For those who lead an active lifestyle, Jumeirah Heights offers various options for outdoor activities. There are multiple gyms and fitness centers within the community, providing classes and equipment for a healthy lifestyle including Reset Fitness and Raise Jumeirah Islands.

Residents of Jumeirah Heights have convenient access to a selection of beauty salons located in nearby communities, ensuring they don't have to travel far for pampering and grooming services.

In Jumeirah Lake Towers, a few popular choices include Tips & Toes, which offers nail services, hair treatments, and massages, and The Loft Fifth Avenue, known for its trendy haircuts and styling services. Additionally, Beauty Connection Spa in the nearby Springs community provides a broad range of services from hair care to extensive spa treatments.

One important consideration before moving to Jumeirah Heights is the community's location relative to major business centers and daily commute times. While Jumeirah Heights offers a tranquil residential setting with numerous amenities, it is situated slightly away from Dubai's central business districts.

Prospective residents should evaluate their daily commute, as travel to and from work or school might take longer, depending on the time of day and traffic conditions. Assessing this factor can help ensure that the location aligns well with your lifestyle and daily routines.

What amenities are available in Jumeirah Heights?

Jumeirah Heights offers a wide range of amenities including parks, lakes, fitness centers, and children's play areas. The community is designed to cater to families and professionals, providing a comfortable and convenient living environment with everything from supermarkets to cafes and restaurants within easy reach.

How accessible is public transportation from Jumeirah Heights?

While Jumeirah Heights itself is primarily a residential area, it is conveniently located near several major bus routes. The nearest metro station, DMCC Metro Station, is about a 15-minute drive away, offering easy access to the rest of Dubai.

Are there schools near Jumeirah Heights?

Yes, there are several reputable schools and nurseries close to Jumeirah Heights. Notable institutions include The Arcadia Preparatory School and The Winchester School, both within a 15-minute drive, offering British curriculum and a range of extracurricular activities.

What are the dining options in and around Jumeirah Heights?

Jumeirah Heights hosts a variety of dining options ranging from casual cafes to upscale restaurants. Nearby, Jumeirah Lake Towers and Dubai Marina provide even more diverse culinary experiences with a multitude of international cuisines and dining styles to choose from, all within a 20-minute drive from the community.
